mission.title: prometheus: Support Unix socket for metrics address
mission.description: Support Unix socket for metrics address. Requested by 47+ users.

steps.title: Check current prometheus deployment
steps.description:
Verify your prometheus version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n prometheus -l app.kubernetes.io/name=prometheus
helm list -n prometheus 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working prometheus installation.

steps.title: Review prometheus configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant prometheus configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n prometheus -l app.kubernetes.io/name=prometheus
kubectl get configmap -n prometheus -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=prometheus
```
### Proposal

For current Prometheus, it seems that the metrics address to be pulled must be a valid TCP hostname. If Prometheus supports to pull from HTTP over Unix socket, each metrics server won't use a dedicated port to serve for Prometheus.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n prometheus -l app.kubernetes.io/name=prometheus
kubectl get events -n prometheus --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Support Unix socket for metrics address" is functioning correctly.
